national_news.title: Swiss President Visit to India & 2nd India-EFTA Prosperity Summit
bullets: Swiss President Guy Parmelin undertook a three-day state visit to India to review bilateral cooperation in trade, investment, science, and innovation with PM Narendra Modi.
The visit marks the participation in the 2nd India-EFTA Prosperity Summit, celebrating the first anniversary of the India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA).
Switzerland remains India's largest trade and investment partner among all European Free Trade Association (EFTA) member countries.

national_news.title: India Finishes 4th at 2026 Asian Games with 85 Medals
bullets: India concluded its 2026 Asian Games campaign in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, in 4th position with 85 medals, comprising 21 gold, 27 silver, and 37 bronze.
India achieved a gold medal sweep across men's and women's events in cricket, kabaddi, and hockey.
The women's hockey team won gold for the first time since 1982 by beating China 1-0, with both men's and women's hockey teams securing 2028 Los Angeles Olympics qualification.

national_news.title: EAM S Jaishankar Highlights New Avenues for Emerging and Middle Powers at Munich Security Conference Event
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar addressed the 62nd Munich Security Conference event in New Delhi, emphasizing supply chain resilience, connectivity, and peace as key agendas for Emerging and Middle Powers (EMPs).
He highlighted strategic multilateral forums and connectivity initiatives, including the Quad, BRICS, India-Middle East-Europe Connectivity Corridor (IMEC), INSTC, and the Northern Sea Route.
The Minister underscored expanding India-EU cooperation in advanced manufacturing, semiconductors, AI, space capabilities, and growing defence exports through domestic start-ups.

national_news.title: PM-SETU Scheme Completes One Year of Implementation
bullets: PM-SETU (Pradhan Mantri Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs) is implemented by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship with a total outlay of Rs 60,000 crore (Rs 30,000 crore Centre, Rs 20,000 crore States, and Rs 10,000 crore Industry).
The scheme aims to modernise Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs); 850 ITIs have been identified so far, comprising 172 Hub ITIs and 678 Spoke ITIs across 200 identified clusters.
Strategic Investment Plans for 14 ITI clusters have been approved under the National Steering Committee (NSC) with an investment exceeding Rs 3,446 crore.

national_news.title: All India Institute of Ayurveda Concludes Swachhata Hi Seva Campaign 2026
bullets: The All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA) observed the Swachhata Hi Seva 2026 campaign from September 17 to October 2 under the theme 'Swachhata Mein Sabhag, Swachh Bharat, Viksit Bharat'.
The initiative integrated environmental sustainability drives including a plantation drive under the 'Ek Ped Ma Ke Naam' initiative.
Post-campaign activities continue under Special Campaign 6.0 until October 31 with a dedicated focus on the 'Effective Collection, Segregation and Disposal of e-waste'.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Health Department Revises Essential Drug List to Expand Specialised Care
bullets: The Bihar health department has revised its Essential Drug List (EDL) to include specialized medicines and 16 medical devices/consumables for dialysis, cervical cancer, and hemophilia.
Key additions include Factor VIII medicines, Pap smear kits, Karman cannulas, updated rabies treatments, and Tenecteplase for emergency heart attack management.
The expansion of critical drugs to district hospitals, CHCs, and trauma centers aims to reduce out-of-pocket healthcare expenses for needy families.

bihar_news.title: RBI Monetary Policy Committee Evaluates Repo Rate Adjustments Amid Inflation Risks
bullets: The RBI Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) convened to review key policy rates, considering a 25 basis point hike to raise the repo rate from 5.25% to 5.50%.
The potential rate revision is driven by rising global crude oil prices exceeding the $90/barrel benchmark and Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation rising to 4.82% in August.
The central bank had maintained a real GDP growth target of 6.7% for FY2026-27, with strong domestic economic momentum providing headroom to focus on inflation control.

bihar_news.title: New Mokama Rail Bridge Commissioned over Ganges in Bihar
bullets: A new double-line rail bridge over the Ganges at Mokama began operations with the Mahananda Express, significantly boosting rail capacity between north and south Bihar.
The Rs 2,400 crore project spans 1.86 km (with total project length of 14 km) and was constructed to replace speed restrictions of the old Rajendra Setu, allowing train speeds of up to 140 kmph.
Sanctioned in the 2015-16 Rail Budget and launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in March 2016, the construction was executed by Afcons Infrastructure under IRCON International.
